units.source_text: 男人大多提心吊膽，重面子與形式，其實小氣），

en.t: Most men are timid, obsessed with appearances and formalities, and in truth rather petty,

units.source_text: 香菸店的良子成為跟我同居的未辦結婚登記的妻子，

en.t: Yoshiko from the tobacco shop became my unregistered wife and lived with me,

units.source_text: 我們在築地隅田川附近的一家木造二樓公寓，租下一樓的一個房間居住。

en.t: We rented a room on the first floor of a two-story wooden apartment house near the Sumida River in Tsukiji and lived there.

units.source_text: 我戒了酒，全力以赴地投入已漸漸成為我固定職業的漫畫創作中。

en.t: I gave up drinking and threw myself wholeheartedly into drawing manga, which was gradually becoming my regular occupation.

units.source_text: 晚飯後我們倆一起去看電影，回家途中還順路去咖啡館小坐，或是買個花盆，

en.t: After dinner the two of us would go to see a movie, stop at a cafe on the way home, or buy a flowerpot,

units.source_text: 不，比起這些，更讓我歡心的是聽這位完全信任我的小新娘說話，

en.t: No, more than any of that, what delighted me was listening to this young bride who trusted me completely,

units.source_text: 以及看她一舉手一投足的一顰一笑，

en.t: and watching every gesture, every frown, and every smile she made,

units.source_text: 慢慢覺得自己越來越像一個正常人，

en.t: and I slowly began to feel that I was becoming more and more like a normal person,

units.source_text: 不至於以悲慘的結局了結自己的一生。

en.t: and that I might not have to bring my life to an end in misery after all.
